title: In-place reversal
prompt: Implement `void reverse(int[] arr)`: reverse the array in place using swaps — no new array. Odd-length arrays have a untouched middle element. Trace {1,2,3,4} swap by hand: (0,3) then (1,2).

tests.name: in place reversal
tests.hint: for i from 0 while i < arr.length / 2: swap arr[i] with arr[arr.length - 1 - i]
